observed_result.summary: Observed on fixture ca1: a dedicated agent (HOME=<tmp> ssh-agent -U -d -a <tmp>/agent/agent.sock) holding a disposable ed25519 K_env plus certificate (private file deleted after ssh-add -t 120) listed exactly 2 entries (ED25519, ED25519-CERT, both K_env). Fresh login rc 0 with exactly 1 new Accepted line carrying the certificate ID and 1 agent sign request. With IdentityAgent=none rc 255, no Accepted line. ssh -G and ssh -vvv referenced only the temp socket (0 foreign paths, 0 <home>/.ssh references). After the 120 s lifetime: ssh-add -l 'The agent has no identities.' (rc 1), ssh-add -T rc 1, fresh login rc 255, 2 agent 'expiring key' log lines. Exact-PID kill: agent terminated, socket removed. Verdict pass.
